items.work: Chôros Nos. 2, 3, 10 and 12; Introduction to the Chôros; Two Chôros (bis)
items.performers: São Paulo Symphony Orchestra and Choir; John Neschling, conductor; Fabio Zanon, guitar; Cláudio Cruz, violin; Johannes Gramsch, cello; Elizabeth Plunk, flute; Ovanir Buosi, clarinet
items.recorded: December 2003 and February 2005, Sala São Paulo
items.label: BIS (BIS-1520)
items.note: Chôros No. 3 for male chorus, Chôros No. 10 for chorus and orchestra with Brazilian percussion, and the Introduction to the Chôros for guitar and orchestra on one disc, released in 2008, with a booklet note by Jorge Coli.

items.work: Complete works for solo guitar: Five Preludes, Suite populaire brésilienne, Twelve Études, Chôros No. 1
items.label: BIS (BIS-686)
items.note: The five preludes of 1940, the five pieces of the suite, the twelve studies dedicated to Segovia and Chôros No. 1, about seventy-eight minutes in all, released in 1995.

items.work: Bachianas Brasileiras Nos. 1 and 5; Suite for voice and violin; four Bach preludes and fugues arranged for cellos
items.performers: Pleeth Cello Octet; Jill Gomez, soprano; Peter Manning, violin
items.recorded: May 1987, All Hallows, Gospel Oak, London
items.label: Hyperion (Helios, CDH55316)
items.note: Both Bachianas for an orchestra of cellos, No. 5 with soprano, with the Suite for voice and violin and four of Villa-Lobos’s 1941 Bach transcriptions for cellos. Simon Wright’s booklet note, the source for several points on this page, discusses the Chôros, the Bachianas, the Suite and the transcriptions.
